lessons.title: Area Approximation

explanation_sections.title: Area Approximation
explanation_sections.body:
Area approximation estimates the area under a curve or of an irregular shape. Methods include
counting squares, using ordinates and using trapezia. Trapezium area = ½(a+b)h.

questions.prompt: Find area of a trapezium with parallel sides 8 cm and 14 cm, height 5 cm.
Find area when parallel sides are 3 cm and 7 cm, height 4 cm.
Why can narrower trapezia improve an estimate under a smooth curve?
questions.correct_answer: Narrower strips usually follow the curve more closely.

questions.prompt: Describe how ordinates can be used to estimate area under a curve.
questions.correct_answer: Measure ordinates at selected points and add estimated strip areas.
